segments.title: 第43章 第一頓午餐
segments.content:
Rekindling the Verdant Years Chapter 43: The First Lunch

Fortunately, it was just the start of the school year, and everyone's relationships weren't that familiar yet. The boys just watched silently, with no one starting any ruckus.

Li Luo sighed softly, already getting a taste of Ying Chanxi's influence at school.

It had to be said that some girls, even in a school uniform, would still be the most dazzling one in a crowd.

Ever since the summer prep class began, Ying Chanxi had quickly become the recognized school belle among the boys in the early admission batch.

No one had deliberately held a private vote.

But when you saw Ying Chanxi's face, no matter who you were, you would probably subconsciously decide in your heart that this must be the so-called school belle, right?

Li Luo turned to glance at Ying Chanxi's side profile, but he didn't have too many thoughts.

Perhaps it was because he had seen her so much growing up that he had gotten used to it.

"It's not like I don't know where the cafeteria is. Do I need you to lead the way?"

"I came all this way to find you out of the kindness of my heart, and you're not even grateful?"

"If you're treating for lunch today, I can reluctantly accept your kindness."

"You wish." Ying Chanxi shot him a look. "Let's go, or we'll have to wait in a long line."

Under the watchful eyes of the crowd, the two went downstairs together and walked toward the cafeteria.

On the asphalt road to the cafeteria, two distinct groups of people had formed.

The new students from the regular classes, who had just enrolled today, hadn't been issued school uniforms yet, so they were all dressed in their own casual clothes, creating a colorful sight.

The students from the prep class, however, were wearing the standard blue and white uniform of Fuyi High School, walking together in groups.

A pair like Ying Chanxi and Li Luo, one in a school uniform and one in casual clothes, and a boy and a girl at that, was quite a rare sight on the road.

"What did you guys in the prep class do this morning?" Li Luo asked, casually starting a conversation as they walked, ignoring the faint stares from their surroundings.

"Nothing much." Ying Chanxi shook her head. "They just went over the important points for the military training, then told us to go for a physical check-up in the afternoon. The rest of the time was for self-study. What about you guys?"

"Us?" Li Luo smiled, then suddenly extended a hand toward Ying Chanxi and said, "Hello, let me reintroduce myself. I am the class monitor of Class Eight, Grade Ten, Li Luo. It's a pleasure to meet you."

Ying Chanxi blinked as he spoke, then her eyebrows shot up in surprise. She immediately shook his hand, squeezing it tightly as she asked, "Really? You actually became the class monitor?"

"Is there any need to lie to you about something like this?" Li Luo released his childhood friend's soft, delicate hand and chuckled. "I defeated three strong competitors to win this position. The class monitor from the class next to ours in junior high can only be my subordinate."

"Hua Xiuxiu?" Ying Chanxi narrowed her eyes. "She's the vice monitor?"

"Yep."

"I remember she's very pretty."

"You pay attention to that?" Li Luo was a little surprised. "Don't you know that when a girl who looks like you praises another girl for being pretty, it carries a faint sense of condescension?"

"I do not! I'm just telling the truth."

"Why so worked up? I'm just telling the truth too."

"So how did you become the class monitor?" Ying Chanxi asked, a bit curious. "You don't have any experience being a monitor, but she has a proper background as one. How is she not better than you?"

"That's where you're wrong." Li Luo wagged his finger and spun a tale for her. "Remember when I came to Affiliated High No. 1 to play basketball before? One of the teachers who played with me happens to be our class's head teacher."

"And then?"

"The head teacher thought my basketball skills were good, so he went against all opposition and had me elected as monitor. I call it basketball politics."

Ying Chanxi looked at him with an expression that said "how childish," not even bothering to say another word to him.

The two chatted idly all the way and soon followed the asphalt road to the cafeteria next to the basketball court.

"So this is the cafeteria." Li Luo looked up at the three or four-story building in front of him. "I saw it before when I was playing basketball."

"There are two floors for students to eat, and the third floor is for teachers. We can't go up there." Ying Chanxi led him into the cafeteria, explaining as they walked, "The dishes on the first floor are cheaper, and the second floor is a bit more expensive."

"They have different tiers?" Li Luo raised his eyebrows, thinking that key high schools really are different.

"On the first floor, vegetable dishes are 1.5 yuan and meat dishes are 3 yuan. On the second floor, vegetable dishes are 2 yuan and meat dishes are 4 yuan." Ying Chanxi led Li Luo to the second floor. "The difference isn't that big, really. Sometimes if there's a dish I like on the first floor, I'll eat there too."

"Then why are you taking me to the second floor?"

"There are fewer people on the second floor." Ying Chanxi, walking ahead, turned her head and rolled her eyes at him. "Besides, didn't you say you wanted me to treat you?"

"Oh, you're too kind." Li Luo followed her up to the second floor. "How many meat dishes can I order?"

"Shameless," Ying Chanxi muttered under her breath, then said, "Let's each get two different dishes, that way we'll have four."

"You're quite clever."

The two went to the end of the line and waited for five or six minutes before reaching the service window.

Coincidentally, Shao Heqi was getting food at the next window. When he saw Li Luo and Ying Chanxi queuing together, his eyes immediately filled with a look of envy mixed with a hint of jealousy.

The thought that this guy had also just become the class monitor made Shao Heqi feel even worse.

But just as he was about to pretend he hadn't seen anything and quietly leave this heart-wrenching place with his tray, he saw Li Luo waiting to the side with his tray, not taking out his meal card.

It wasn't until Ying Chanxi had also finished ordering her food and took out her own meal card, swiping it for 16 yuan, that Shao Heqi's eyebrows twitched.

Damn!

This bastard!

He's even mooching off Ying Chanxi's meal card for lunch.

He really deserves to die.

Shao Heqi cursed internally, quickening his pace to leave the area, not daring to look any longer.

Especially since he wasn't in the same class as Ying Chanxi and hadn't secured the position of monitor or even vice monitor, he didn't even know how to greet her.

At this thought, Shao Heqi felt a sense of sorrow and simply carried his tray to the first floor to eat, so he wouldn't see anything else that would upset him.

As for Li Luo and Ying Chanxi, they hadn't noticed Shao Heqi at all.

After swiping the card, Ying Chanxi followed behind Li Luo and found a seat by the window.

However, just as the two started to eat, Xu Yinghuan and Jin Yuting, who had just gotten their food, spotted them and walked over to their table.

"Monitor and former monitor, can we two sit here?" Xu Yinghuan walked to the table with a grin, tray in hand, teasing the two of them.

"Go ahead and sit." Ying Chanxi pointed to the two empty seats opposite them and greeted the girls, "Yinghuan and Yuting, did you two run for any class officer positions?"

"Nope." Xu Yinghuan shook her head. "They only elected the monitor, vice monitor, and sports representative this morning. We're not as amazing as Li Luo, how could we have been chosen?"

"What's so amazing about him?" Ying Chanxi glanced at Li Luo and picked up a piece of sweet and sour pork tenderloin from his plate. "Who knows what kind of crooked methods he used."
